Manual entry validated against the format
Concurrent uploads of the same file deduplicate

Currency shown with correct symbol and precision
Dates render in the user's locale
Null and empty values have a placeholder
Special characters render as text, not entities
Empty state shown for zero results
Each sortable column sorts both ways
Direct URL access loads each valid route
Deep links reach the specific state
Keyboard navigation follows a logical order
Reset returns every field to initial values
Browser autofill does not override user input
Field errors appear next to their fields
Server errors surface a friendly message
Currency conversion uses the right rate and rounding
JavaScript errors do not crash the page
Loading states shown on async work
Errors say what to do next
403 says it is a permissions problem
429 tells the user when to retry
Requests carry the right method, headers and body
Responses parsed for success and error shapes
Auth tokens attached to authenticated calls
API timeout produces a user message
Third-party outage does not block core flows
CDN failure falls back to origin
What the user entered is what got saved
What was saved is what is retrieved
Session timeout does not lose unsaved data
